question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only. (Note: All numbers are single digit numbers only.)

(Left) @ 8 $ (Right)

If all the numbers are dropped from the series, which of the following will be seventh from the left?
solution:
Given: (Left) @ 8 $ (Right)

Now, 

Symbols, which are immediately preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

So, Needed pattern is: Number - Symbol - Number.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d3498daf2dfe013b0ed63302d6c251e4d04c02ac611ca1a07e5dd624d2fcbd0.png] 

There are 5 Symbols which are preceded by a number and also immediately followed by a number.

Hence, the correct answer is* 'Option 4'.*
